$comment: What the Domains extension of the guidelines adds to the schema of the guidelines: the header a domain's specification opens with (s-yggv9myedprnaa7), and the consumes link by which a header names the sections of other domains the domain uses.

schema.$comment: The header of a domain: the node a domain's specification opens with. Its text says what the domain does. It names its owners where the domain has owners of its own, and its level where it has one. Where the domain has sections, it carries their index, which the reindex builds from them and nothing writes by hand (s-2r59txnms5serdr). Its status, like a section's, is built from the nodes under it.

level.$comment: The name of the level the domain stands at, one of those the project's own guidelines list (s-nkyty4dy9x2v2a4); validate checks it against that list, which the schema cannot see. Absent where the domain is given no level.

sections.$comment: The index of the domain's sections, in the order they read: each one's sid, title and text, and the headers of the domains that use it. Absent where the domain has no sections. Built by the reindex from the sections; validate refuses an index they do not produce.

usedBy.$comment: Read off the section's incoming consumes links; absent where no domain uses it.
